english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who lacks physical coordination or dexterity.
Use this specifically for someone who is clumsy with their hands or movements.

examples.english: I'm really clumsy and always break things.
examples.traditional: 我真係笨手笨腳，成日打爛啲嘢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 ban6 sau2 ban6 goek3 seng4 jat6 daa2 laan6 di1 je5

examples.english: I was awkward with my hands the first time I made a cake.
examples.traditional: 我第一次整蛋糕，成日都笨手笨腳。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 zing2 daan6 gou1 seng4 jat6 dou1 ban6 sau2 ban6 goek3
